info.name: Bumpa API v0.5
info.description:
Overview

Staging URL: api.bumpa.xyz
Production URL: api.getbumpa.com

This collection covers the core commerce endpoints of the Bumpa platform, organized into the following functional areas:

Orders

Manage the full order lifecycle ΓÇö retrieve paginated order lists with filtering support, update shipping statuses, and retry failed shipping attempts.

Analytics

Access business intelligence data across three domains:

  • Sales ΓÇö overview, total sales, gross profit, and net profit metrics for a given location and date range.

  • Products ΓÇö product analytics overview, units sold, top-selling, and least-selling products.

  • Customers ΓÇö customer analytics overview and top customers ranked by order value.

All endpoints are scoped to a location_id and use {{url}} / https://api.your-bumpa-domain.com environment variables for the base URL, with authentication handled via an API Key under Header X-Api-Key

request.description:
Get Orders

Retrieves a paginated list of orders for a given location. Supports filtering by price, collection, status, and keyword search.

Method: GET
Endpoint: {{url}}/api/commerce/v1/orders

Query Parameters

Parameter Type Required Description
location_id integer Required Filter orders by location ID.
price number Optional Filter orders by a specific price value.
collection integer Optional Filter orders by collection ID.
status integer Optional Filter orders by status. For example, 1 = active/pending.
limit integer Optional Limit the number of results returned.
search string Optional Search orders by keyword, such as a product name (e.g. 7in1 PACKING CUBES).

Example Request

GET {{url}}/api/commerce/v1/orders?location_id=4047&status=1&limit=5

Authentication

This request requires a valid API Key. Ensure it is set in Header under X-Api-Key
